summary: IsColumn and IsRowType are given. With a prime g_l ≠ ℓ and the chosen place w_i over g_l carrying a primitive label (or X − 1 in rank one): a tame element s has eigenvalues ιℓT(ξ^{q^a}) that stay residually distinct, so every lattice spans all matrices and a power of Frobenius acts by a scalar; s^e acts by a scalar of large order. At the places above g the inertia acts with eigenvalues that are roots of unity of orders dividing g_i^d − 1, whose ℓ-adic distances to 1 are at most cr_ℓ.
